subject: You were BORN for more
body: Most people stay broke because they think small. My course EMPIRE is 200 DOLR — but for you, today, 20 DOLR. Reply to claim it.

outcomes.when: the player signs up for or buys the course
outcomes.reply: Welcome to the 1%. Watch your inbox.

hints: It costs 20 DOLR. Reply only if you want in.
